description: Laravel Pulse for every Laravel variant of the addon: laravel/pulse ^1.11, the published config (plus a `viewers` list from PULSE_VIEWERS), the pulse tables migration, App\Domain\Providers\PulseServiceProvider with the `viewPulse` gate (administrators and PULSE_VIEWERS), the provider in the `providers` slot, PULSE_* keys in .env.example, a `pulse:check` Supervisor program in the production image (`supervisor-programs` slot), docs/pulse.md linked from the README (`addons` slot) and a feature test of the dashboard.
